entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Yeah, hi. I need to process a return. Order number is VF-774-901.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. Let me just pull that up... VF-774-901. I see it's for a Pro-Team jersey. What specifically is the issue with the item?
It's the wrong size. I just tried it on and it's way too tight.

I understand. One moment while I check the delivery date... Okay, I see it was delivered 74 days ago. According to our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window. We can definitely get this sorted out for you.
Good. Do you do an exchange or do I have to re-order?

We can process a direct exchange. I am generating a pre-paid return label and sending it to the email on file right now. Just send the original jersey back, and as soon as we scan it in at our warehouse, we'll ship out the next size up for you.
Okay, got the email. That's all I needed. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
